capabilities: Render Mermaid diagrams at natural size, shrinking wide ones to a configurable maximum width
Resize previews from the bottom-right corner and remember dimensions per note and diagram
Open a compact viewer with zoom, pan, Fit, and 2x PNG export
Preserve Pele color variables and font styles, with consistent styling across themes
Import saved dimensions from Better Mermaid on first launch
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; it renders and manages Mermaid diagram previews in notes.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation from GitHub Releases is required. The README notes desktop-only corner resizing and outstanding mobile real-device testing, and warns that the saved-dimensions data.json may contain note paths and should not be committed publicly.
intentEvidence: Includes viewer components adapted from Better Mermaid 1.0.8 by Joven Lynn under the MIT license.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid rendering offers no resizing of previews, no remembered diagram dimensions, and limited pan-and-zoom viewing.

relations.evidence: Mermaid Cards adds natural/resizable previews, persistent dimensions, Pele compatibility fixes, export color preservation, integrated appearance, and pixel-based settings.

summary: Mermaid diagram preview enhancer that renders diagrams at natural size with corner-resizable frames, saved per-diagram dimensions, and a pan-and-zoom viewer.
